title: Expose recovery_required as a host-executable control directive
outcome: A recovery_required refusal tells the host exactly how to recover and never assigns an impossible action to an agent that has not been admitted.
acceptance: Protocol tests cover an ordinary turn refused while sync_required, a host-issued recovery turn accepted with a partial page, continued recovery until ready, and subsequent ordinary grant admission.
TermAl renders this directive as recovery in progress or actionable host failure, not as an agent policy denial.
The control directive for recovery_required targets the component that can legally submit the recovery turn; it does not require an ungranted agent to perform a recovery checkpoint.

The host-facing contract distinguishes automatic delivery-page recovery from agent checkpoint recovery and documents the required purpose, retry identity, paging, cancellation, and completion behavior.
disposal_reason: Obsolete: 9eeb3cf removed recovery turns and grant delivery pages, so the recovery_required admission path this item would expose no longer exists (docs/shipped.md:70); TermAl accepts grants without a delivery page today. Triage 2026-09-27, consultation Engram::Fable, Termal::Fable, Engram::Coder, unanimous.
